text: Hogsme, professor. Hogsme is the only
all wizarding village in Britain and is
home to an array of shops and pubs. You
should be able to find all of the school
supplies you require in Hogsme. You will
also, I imagine, enjoy many a butterbeer
there with friends in due course.
Okay. What is butterbeer?
Thank you, Professor Weasley. a lot to
absorb on your first day and you have
much to learn. Peppery, your professors
have agreed to create additional
assignments for you outside of class.
You'll be up to speed in no time.

earlier, I'd say Professor Fig succeeded
in at least showing you the basics. He
